public_rationale: The deadline, the end of 2025, has passed. In August 2025, OpenAI's CEO said GPT-5 was still missing important things under common definitions of AGI. In December 2025, the ARC Prize organizers said the grand prize was unclaimed and answered 'do we have AGI?' with 'Not yet.' I found no evidence that any system was widely accepted as AGI during 2025. The forecast held.
limitations: AGI has no agreed definition. A few individuals may have claimed AGI informally, but no wide acceptance was found.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AGI will not be achieved in 2025.

statement.excerpt: I will stand by my own predictions that we won’t see AGI in 2025
statement.document_title: AGI isn’t coming in 2025, and GPT-5 probably isn’t either.

our_interpretation: Read as: no AI system widely accepted as AGI will appear by 31 December 2025.
Leading developers or AGI benchmark stewards saying no AGI exists by the end of 2025 counts as support.
criteria.support_condition: By the end of 2025, no AI system is widely accepted as AGI. Leading labs and AGI benchmark organizers say AGI has not been reached.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A system released in 2025 is widely accepted as AGI, for example declared by its developer and confirmed by independent evaluators, or it passes leading AGI benchmarks at human level.
